instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Stop a website answering at one of its addresses", and give it host.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:let_go_of_site_address and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: The site stops answering at host (a name or your own domain), and every earlier name that sent visitors to it goes too.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: undefined (list_files, find_file, read_file, write_file_start, write_file_piece, write_file_finish).
